title: Prisma Dual Cleavers
extract:
The Prisma Dual Cleavers are the special Prisma version of the  Dual Cleavers, featuring enhanced attack speed and status chance, while lowering  Puncture and  Impact damage to increase  Slash damage.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Can use the Dual Cleavers-exclusive  Justice Blades mod.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Carving Mantis,  Crossing Snakes and  Dividing Blades (Conclave only) stance.
Innate  polarity.
Advantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Above average crit chance (25.00%)
High block angle (60°)
Above average attack speed (1.000x animation speed)
Very high crit multiplier (3.00x)
Slam Attack (wiki attack index 2)
Above average crit chance (25.00%)
Above average attack speed (1.000x animation speed)
Very high block angle (60°)
Very high crit multiplier (3.00x)
Heavy Slam Attack (wiki attack index 3)
Above average crit chance (25.00%)
Above average attack speed (1.000x animation speed)
Very high block angle (60°)
Very high crit multiplier (3.00x)
Disadvantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Very low total damage (133)
Low damage × attack speed (199.5)
Very low follow through (0.5x)
Very low attack range (1.70 m)
Below average disposition (●●●○○ (1.10x))
Slam Attack (wiki attack index 2)
Low total damage (266)
Very low follow through (0.5x)
Below average damage × attack speed (399)

Very low status chance (10.00%)

See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Comparisons:

 Prisma Dual Cleavers (Normal Attack), compared to  Dual Cleavers (Normal Attack):
Lower base damage (133.00 vs. 157.00)
Lower  Impact damage ( 13.3 vs.  23.55)
Lower  Puncture damage ( 13.3 vs.  23.55)
Lower  Slash damage ( 106.4 vs.  109.9)
Lower total damage (133 vs. 157)
Higher base status chance (25.00% vs. 10.00%)
Higher attack speed (1.000x animation speed vs. 0.833x animation speed)
Higher Mastery Rank required (9 vs. 5)
Lower disposition (●●●○○ (1.10x) vs. ●●●●○ (1.20x))

Acquisition
The Prisma Dual Cleavers is potentially sold by Baro Ki'Teer in the Concourse section of the Tenno Relay for  200,000 and  490. Note that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and this weapon may not be available on a succeeding appearance.
The weapon can be traded, but only for unranked copies without Forma and Orokin Catalyst installed. The trading recipient must also have a Mastery Rank of at least 9.
